assumptions: MCU present: no MCU; load switch is logic-controlled via a discrete gate driver, per brief (defaulted).
Load switch topology: P-channel MOSFET high-side switch with gate driven by an NPN/level-shift stage from a logic-level control input (defaulted).
Load switch 10 A: MOSFET selected for >=10 A continuous drain current with low RDS(on) and adequate thermal pad (defaulted).
Control input: logic-level (3.3 V/5 V tolerant) gate drive via level shifter; no MCU (defaulted).
Thermal pad: MOSFET thermal pad connected to a dedicated thermal net on the load-switch sheet, tied to the load return (defaulted).
Power input: 12 V supply from screw terminal, single VBUS rail; no separate 12V rail (defaulted).
Load return: GND is the common return for the 12 V supply and the load (defaulted).
Gate drive: level-shift stage powered from the 12 V input rail (defaulted).
No regulation: no DC-DC converter or LDO needed; load switch is unregulated pass-through (defaulted).
No comms: no communication protocol required for a discrete load switch (defaulted).
Screw terminals: input and output screw terminals on the load-switch sheet (defaulted).
